title: Let a history entry's advertised locator read its complete body
outcome: Let a history entry's advertised locator read its complete body
acceptance: When `show REF --history` prints an entry with a locator and a clipped summary (for example a cancel or reject reason), `show REF --note LOCATOR` (or the remedy the history entry names) returns that entry's complete body

If a history locator is deliberately not readable through `--note`, the history entry prints the exact supported command that does read it, and the refusal for a wrong route names that command instead of only 'does not belong to this item'
A behaviour test covers a reject reason longer than the history clip, read back in full through the advertised route
